g.title: crate Provide locale, calendar and message values and pure text calculations.
crate::date Gregorian dates, months and date ranges with the arithmetic calendars need.
crate::format Public options and values for locale-sensitive formatting.
crate::interpolate Substitute named arguments in message templates.
crate::locale A locale (a BCP 47 language tag) and the regional conventions it carries.
crate::messages The texts components show, by key.
crate::numbers Format and parse decimal numbers using ICU locale symbols and digits.
crate::regional Apply ICU calendar patterns, display names, plural rules, and collation.
